# LLMs.txt for Pianoers.com

This file provides information about Pianoers.com, a website dedicated to helping people learn piano smarter. We offer reviews, guides, and advice related to pianos, keyboards, online lessons, and piano learning resources. Our goal is to provide honest and helpful information for piano learners of all levels.

## Website Structure:

### 1. Homepage
*   [Pianoers.com: Learn Piano Smarter with Reviews & Guides](https://pianoers.com/) - The main landing page of the website.

### 2. About
*   [About Pianoers – Honest Piano Reviews & Real Advice](https://pianoers.com/about/) - Information about the website and its authors.
